item.title: Maryland governor signs bills to end ICE partnerships
item.description: "In Maryland, we will not allow untrained, unqualified and unaccountable agents to deputize our brave local law enforcement officers because Maryland is a community of immigrants," the governor said.

item.title: Families to remain evacuated for another '24 to 72 hours' after Centreville home explosion
